serving.notes: config.json is Gemma3ForCausalLM, model_type gemma3_text, max_position_embeddings 32768, float32, no vision_config. The tokenizer has an image token and use_default_system_prompt false. chat_template.jinja can prepend a system message but does not set one. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key. generation_config.json sets top_k 64, top_p 0.95, do_sample true, and no temperature. max_new_tokens 100 is in the card example. No adapter_config.json. The card says the LoRA adapters were merged. The published weight is one F32 file of 268,098,176 parameters. The card does not say whether the base was quantized. The dataset card says the set has 80,000+ pairs and was built from existing medical sets plus AI-generated synthetic data; the size endpoint reports 86,667 train rows. The model card does not say how many of those rows were used. The GitHub link is the dataset author's pipeline, not a training script for this checkpoint. The Gemma 3 technical report does not name this repo.

discrepancies: LoRA and ericrisco/medrescue match. The YAML base_model is google/gemma-3-270m-it, which matches the inventory. The Model Details line says Base Model google/gemma-3-270m, without -it. The card names no loss.
